<subject>Re: Pilbara Iron Joint Venture</subject>
<body>
Adam:

We told James Austin that we would release our parent guarantee and the legal opinion at closing on Wednesday. They were okay with that. If that's a problem, I can fax the guaranty and opinion (once I have it signed), with a letter from me saying you can't release it until funding...
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au
Sent: Tuesday, 30 Apr 2024 9:59 AM
To: l157@norcorco.com; kenneth.lee@tasmanridge.com.au
Cc: vincent.james@tasmanridge.com.au; todd.vaughan@tasmanridge.com.au
Subject: Pilbara Iron Joint Venture

Good morning.

In order to finish up Pilbara Iron Joint Venture tomorrow, please note we need the following today:

Norcor parent guaranty
LOI (so that full payment can be made to Norcor tomorrow)
Opinion of counsel

And once funds are received by Norcor, we need the receipt of funds letter.

Matthew, I haven't heard back from the Karratha gang to find out if the Port Services Agreement is ready. Maybe Jake can help shake that loose.

Thanks,

Adam
</quoted>
